verdict.rationale: Ollama offers local and cloud model endpoints, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no documented sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Claims that local runs stay on the machine and the existence of local vs. cloud base URLs are privacy and deployment features, not a sandbox for testing without touching production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
